source_definition: Annual N2O mole fraction increase in ppb from Jan 1 through Dec 31.
page_definition: Annual increase in globally averaged atmospheric nitrous oxide from globally averaged marine surface data.
limits: The source pages can be revised as new samples and quality control enter NOAA GML processing.
The response digests bind received bytes but do not authenticate NOAA or measurement validity.
Annual atmospheric mole-fraction growth does not identify emissions, source sectors, or causal mechanisms.
